name: Epiphan Pearl

actions.name: Recorder
actions.description: Start / Stop starts a stopped recorder and stops a running or paused one; Start and Stop always send that one command; Pause / Resume pauses a running recorder and resumes a paused one; "All recorders" controls every recorder on the device.

options.label: Recorder
options.choicesNote: Runtime list (state polled from the device): the entry "all" (label "All recorders") first, then one entry per recorder, id = recorder id as string (src/choices.js choicesRecordersWithAll). Default 'all'.

actions.availability: 'All recorders' and Pause / Resume need REST API v2.0 (firmware 4.24.1 or newer); the callback logs a warning and sends nothing otherwise.

actions.name: Stream
actions.description: Start, stop or toggle a channel's stream (publisher). "All publishers" starts or stops every stream configured on the channel.

options.label: Channel
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per channel, id = channel id as string. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Publisher
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: per channel that has publishers, first `${channelId}-all` (label `Channel – All publishers`), then `${channelId}-${publisherId}` per publisher. Ids are strings; the module splits at the first '-'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

actions.availability: The composite id of 'Publisher' carries its own channel; 'Channel' is only used when the composite cannot be parsed.

actions.name: Layout
actions.description: Switch a channel to a layout. The key lights up while that layout is active.

options.label: Channel
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per channel, id = channel id as string. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Layout
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: one entry per channel and layout, id `${channelId}-${layoutId}` (string, label `Channel – Layout`). The module splits at the first '-'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

actions.availability: The composite id of 'Layout' carries its own channel; 'Channel' is not read by the callback.

actions.name: Single Touch
actions.description: Trigger a single-touch control of the encoder (start/stop recording and streaming together). Most devices have only control 0.

options.label: Single touch control
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per single touch control, id = control id as string. Default: '0' when present, otherwise the first entry (preferredId).

actions.availability: Needs REST API v2.0 (firmware 4.24.1 or newer).

actions.name: Bookmark
actions.description: Add a bookmark (marker) to a channel's recording. Bookmarks are only stored while the channel is recording.

options.label: Channel
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per channel, id = channel id as string. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Text
options.description: Shown in the recording’s bookmark list. Keep it short.

actions.name: Get layout data
actions.description: Read a layout's settings as JSON. Choose where to store the result in the action's 'Store result' setting.

options.label: Layout to get
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: one entry per channel and layout, id `${channelId}-${layoutId}` (string, label `Channel – Layout`). The module splits at the first '-'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

actions.availability: Always uses the legacy v1 API. The action has hasResult: true and returns the layout settings as a JSON string.

actions.name: Set layout data
actions.description: Write a layout's settings from a JSON text, e.g. one read with 'Get layout data'.

options.label: Layout to set
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: one entry per channel and layout, id `${channelId}-${layoutId}` (string, label `Channel – Layout`). The module splits at the first '-'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Layout Data
options.description: JSON text describing an encoder layout. A valid text can be retrieved with the Get layout data action. Variables are allowed in this option.

actions.availability: Always uses the legacy v1 API.

actions.name: Get Content Metadata
actions.description: Read a channel's title, author, copyright, comment, description and filename prefix into its metadata variables. The result (all fields as JSON) can be stored with the action's 'Store result' setting.

options.label: Channel
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per channel, id = channel id as string. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

actions.name: Set Content Metadata
actions.description: Set a channel's title, author, copyright, comment, description and filename prefix. Empty fields are not sent unless 'Also send empty fields' is checked.

options.label: Channel
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per channel, id = channel id as string. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Also send empty fields (clears them on the encoder)

actions.name: Output Source
actions.description: Switch the source shown on an HDMI/SDI output of the encoder.

options.label: Output
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per output, id = output id as string. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Source
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: static ids 'multiview', 'deviceinfo', 'console' (labels 'Built-in: Multiview' / 'Built-in: Device info' / 'Built-in: Console'), then one entry per channel (id = channel id, label 'Channel: <name>'), then one entry per video-capable input (id = input id, label 'Input: <name>'). Ids are strings. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

actions.availability: Needs REST API v2.0 (firmware 4.24.1 or newer).

actions.name: Apply Preset
actions.description: Apply a configuration preset stored on the encoder. This can interrupt recordings and streams and the device may reboot.

options.label: Preset
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: configuration presets stored on the device, id = preset name, label 'name (description)' when the preset has a description. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Sections
options.description: Leave empty to apply the whole preset.

options.label: Confirm with a second press
options.description: The first press only arms the button and sets $(<connection label>:confirm_hint); press the same button again within 3 seconds to send the command. Untick to send it immediately.

actions.availability: Needs REST API v2.0 (firmware 4.24.1 or newer). The callback drops section ids that are not in the closed list.

actions.name: Event
actions.description: Pause / resume, stop or extend the ongoing CMS event, start the upcoming one, or control a specific event. A command that does not apply to the event's state is not sent.

options.label: Event
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: the five aliases 'upcoming', 'ongoing', 'running', 'paused', 'completed', then one entry per polled schedule event (id = event id as string, label 'title (status)'). Custom values are allowed. Default 'ongoing'.
options.description: "Ongoing" always targets the event that is currently running or paused, "Upcoming" the next scheduled one. Picking a specific event ties the button to it.

options.label: Action
options.description: Pause / Resume pauses a running event and resumes a paused one. An ongoing event is already started; the upcoming event is started from an "Upcoming" button.

options.label: Action
options.description: Start, the only command that applies to the upcoming event.

options.label: Extend by
options.description: Seconds added to the finish time of the event.

actions.availability: Needs REST API v2.0 (firmware 4.24.1 or newer). The command actually sent depends on the option that is visible: 'op' for ongoing/running/paused, a fixed Start for 'upcoming', 'op_event' for any other event; the three 'Action' options share the label 'Action'.

actions.name: Reboot / Shutdown
actions.description: Reboot or shut down the encoder. Shut down powers the device off completely; it must be switched back on at the device.

options.label: Confirm with a second press
options.description: The first press only arms the button and sets $(<connection label>:confirm_hint); press the same button again within 3 seconds to send the command. Untick to send it immediately.

actions.name: Audio
actions.description: Nudge the capture gain (dB) of an analog input (XLR, TRS, 3.5 mm, RCA) or the audio delay (ms) of any audio input. Rotary ticks arriving within 150 ms are combined into one step.

options.label: Input
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: inputs that carry audio (audio === true), id = input id as string, label 'name (type)'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Adjusts
options.visibleWhen: optionIs('inputId', this.analogInputIds()), i.e. $(options:inputId) == '<id>' for every analog input id of the device, '1 == 0' when there is none (runtime list; analog = input id or device matches /analog|xlr|trs|rca|3[.,]5\s?mm|line[ -]?in|\bmic/i in src/utils.js)

options.label: Adjusts
options.description: Delay. Gain can only be adjusted on analog inputs (XLR, TRS, 3.5 mm, RCA).
options.visibleWhen: !(optionIs('inputId', this.analogInputIds())), i.e. visible for every input that is not analog

options.label: Step
options.description: Gain steps are in dB (0–100), delay steps in milliseconds (−300..300).

actions.availability: Needs REST API v2.0 (firmware 4.24.1 or newer). For an input that is not analog the callback always adjusts the delay, whatever 'Adjusts' holds. Ticks within the rotary window are summed into one settings PATCH.

feedbacks.name: Recorder state
feedbacks.description: True while the selected recorder (or, for "All recorders", the aggregate of every recorder) is in the selected state.

options.label: Recorder
options.choicesNote: Runtime list (state polled from the device): the entry "all" (label "All recorders") first, then one entry per recorder, id = recorder id as string (src/choices.js choicesRecordersWithAll). Default 'all'.

feedbacks.name: Recorder paused (blink)
feedbacks.description: True during the "on" half of a 500 ms blink while the selected recorder (or, for "All recorders", any recorder) is paused, false the rest of the time. Place it after a Paused style on a button to make that style flash; the Recording presets do this on their Pause / Resume keys.

options.label: Recorder
options.choicesNote: Runtime list (state polled from the device): the entry "all" (label "All recorders") first, then one entry per recorder, id = recorder id as string (src/choices.js choicesRecordersWithAll). Default 'all'.

feedbacks.name: Stream state
feedbacks.description: True while the selected publisher (or, for "All publishers", the aggregate of the channel's publishers) is in the selected state.

options.label: Publisher
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: per channel that has publishers, first `${channelId}-all` (label `Channel – All publishers`), then `${channelId}-${publisherId}` per publisher. Ids are strings; the module splits at the first '-'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

feedbacks.name: Layout active
feedbacks.description: True while the selected layout is the active layout of its channel.

options.label: Layout
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: one entry per channel and layout, id `${channelId}-${layoutId}` (string, label `Channel – Layout`). The module splits at the first '-'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

feedbacks.name: Layout preview
feedbacks.description: Show a live preview image of this specific layout on its switch button, whether or not it is currently active. Uses an undocumented endpoint (not in Epiphan's published REST API v2.0 specification, confirmed working by Epiphan) that renders a given layout directly. Requires preview interval > 0 in the connection settings.

options.label: Layout
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: one entry per channel and layout, id `${channelId}-${layoutId}` (string, label `Channel – Layout`). The module splits at the first '-'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

feedbacks.availability: Needs the connection setting 'preview_interval' > 0; the feedback returns the PNG in the png64 property (affectedProperties: ['png64']).

feedbacks.name: Single touch state
feedbacks.description: "On" is true while pressed; "Error" is true while the control reports a failed start.

options.label: Single touch control
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per single touch control, id = control id as string. Default: '0' when present, otherwise the first entry (preferredId).

feedbacks.name: Preview
feedbacks.description: Show a live preview image of a channel, video input or output on the button (requires preview interval > 0 in the connection settings). "Source" lists channels, inputs and outputs together; pick the one matching "Source type".

options.label: Source
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: all channels (label 'Channel: <name>'), then video-capable inputs ('Input: <name>'), then outputs ('Output: <name>'), ids as strings. The id is looked up in the domain chosen in 'Source type'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

feedbacks.availability: Needs the connection setting 'preview_interval' > 0; the feedback returns the PNG in the png64 property (affectedProperties: ['png64']).

feedbacks.name: Output source recently set
feedbacks.description: True while this connection set the selected source on the selected output within the last 5 seconds. The API has no way to read the output source back, so this only reflects what this connection itself last sent, not a value confirmed by the device.

options.label: Output
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per output, id = output id as string. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

options.label: Source
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: static ids 'multiview', 'deviceinfo', 'console' (labels 'Built-in: Multiview' / 'Built-in: Device info' / 'Built-in: Console'), then one entry per channel (id = channel id, label 'Channel: <name>'), then one entry per video-capable input (id = input id, label 'Input: <name>'). Ids are strings. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

feedbacks.name: Event state
feedbacks.description: True while the resolved event (alias or specific id) is in the selected state.

options.label: Event
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: the five aliases 'upcoming', 'ongoing', 'running', 'paused', 'completed', then one entry per polled schedule event (id = event id as string, label 'title (status)'). Custom values are allowed. Default 'ongoing'.

feedbacks.name: Event command applies
feedbacks.description: True while the selected command would be sent for the resolved event's current status (the same rule the "Event" action itself uses to decide whether a fixed command applies).

options.label: Event
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: the five aliases 'upcoming', 'ongoing', 'running', 'paused', 'completed', then one entry per polled schedule event (id = event id as string, label 'title (status)'). Custom values are allowed. Default 'ongoing'.

feedbacks.name: System condition
feedbacks.description: True while the selected system or AFU condition holds.

feedbacks.name: Storage level
feedbacks.description: True while the selected storage is in the selected condition.

options.label: Storage
options.choicesNote: Runtime list from the polled device state: one entry per storage, id = storage id as string. Default: 'main' when present, otherwise the first entry (preferredId).

feedbacks.name: Audio meter
feedbacks.description: Stereo level meter for an audio input: two bars with peak ticks on the right edge of the button, green to 62%, amber to 82%, red above, over -60..0 dBFS. Placing it starts a 500 ms level poll; the button keeps its own text.

options.label: Input
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: inputs that carry audio (audio === true), id = input id as string, label 'name (type)'. Default: the first entry of the list (empty string while the list is empty).

feedbacks.name: Action failed (recent)
feedbacks.description: True for three seconds on the button whose last device command failed (rejected, timed out or unreachable), so the key itself shows the failure; the message is in the last_error variable.

feedbacks.name: Confirm pending
feedbacks.description: True while a confirm-gated action on this button is armed, waiting for a second press. Puts the hint on the key in place of the label.

notes: Complete list: 14 actions (src/actions.js, getActions) and 15 feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js, getFeedbacks), all registered by key in one object each; nothing is generated per channel or model. Actions and feedbacks are re-registered by updateSystem() (src/instance.js) when the polled device state changes, so every dropdown list that comes from the device (channels, layouts, publishers, recorders, inputs, outputs, storages, presets, events, single touch controls) is runtime data and recorded as choicesNote.

Protocol: HTTP(S) REST to the encoder (connection settings host, port default 80, username default 'admin', HTTPS and self-signed options in src/config.js). REST API v2.0 (firmware 4.24.1 or newer) is preferred; the legacy v1 API is used for layout data, recorder reset fallback and older firmware. Actions marked 'needs REST API v2.0' log a warning and send nothing on v1 devices.

Built on @companion-module/base 2.2.2: options support expressions. Fields that other fields refer to in their visibility expression set disableAutoExpression (eventRef, op, op_event, inputId). Text options are already variable-resolved by Companion (useVariables), the module does not parse them again.

Option defaults written as firstId(...) or preferredId(...) depend on the device list at registration time; they are described in choicesNote, not stored as default. Option tooltips are recorded as description; the "static-text" options of the event and audio actions carry no value and are recorded as type other (rawType static-text) with their text in description.

Composite ids: layout, publisher and getLayoutData/setLayoutData ids have the form `${channelId}-${itemId}` and are split at the first '-' (splitPair in src/utils.js; valuePattern ^[^-]+-.+$ mirrors that rule). The 'Channel' option of the layout action is not read by the callback; the stream action only uses its 'Channel' option when the publisher id cannot be split.

The 'power' and 'preset' actions carry a confirm checkbox (default true): the first press only arms the button, the second press within 3 seconds sends the command (src/confirm.js). Reboot / Shutdown, Apply Preset (may interrupt recordings and reboot the device) and the layout/metadata writes change the device; treat them as write operations.
Variables, presets (src/presets.js) and config fields are not catalogued. Feedback defaultStyle values are not catalogued.

Checked by hand against the source while writing: all 14 actions and 15 feedbacks (ids, names, descriptions, option ids, labels, defaults, closed choice lists, bounds, visibility expressions). Module was not run; the Event visibility strings are the expansion of the optionIs() helper (src/actions.js) written out by hand.
